_note: Character kits: a starting weapon plus three abilities (key 1 from the start of a run, key 2 at run level 5, key 3 = ultimate at run level 10), balanced against the Fire Wizard (Inferno 30 s, Fire Nova 45 s / 80 dmg, Meteor 2 min / 250 dmg). Damage numbers scale with the Damage stat. In 'lines', {braces} mark the numbers the tooltip highlights. Icons are drawn by scripts/ability_glyphs.gd.

weapon.name: Fireballs
weapon.desc: Auto-aimed fireballs that pierce

ice_wizard.role: Crowd control: slows, freezes and shatters

weapon.name: Frost Shards
weapon.desc: Piercing icicles that slow goblins 30% for 2 s

abilities.name: Flash Freeze
abilities.text: Freezes every goblin around you solid.
lines: Goblins within {15 m} are frozen for {3 s} and take {+50%} damage while frozen
Frozen goblins that die shatter for {40%} of their max HP to goblins within {2 yd}; shatters chain

abilities.name: Glacial Path
abilities.text: Skate across the swamp on a trail of ice.
lines: {+60%} move speed for {6 s}
Your ice trail lasts {5 s}: goblins on it are slowed {60%} and take {15} damage per second

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
abilities.text: A blizzard swallows everything around you.
lines: {25 m} blizzard centred on you for {8 s}: goblins inside are slowed {80%} and take {4%} of max HP per second
When it ends, every goblin inside freezes for {2 s}, then shatters for {200} damage

weapon.name: Arcane Bolts
weapon.desc: Homing bolts that bounce to 2 more goblins

abilities.name: Time Warp
abilities.text: Slows time for everyone but you.
lines: Goblins within {20 m} move and attack {70%} slower for {5 s}
Your attack speed is {+50%} while it lasts

abilities.name: Polymorph
abilities.text: Turns the nearest goblins into frogs.
lines: Up to {40} goblins within {20 m} become frogs for {8 s} (not the boss)
Frogs are harmless, take {double} damage and give {2x} XP if killed

abilities.name: Rewind
abilities.text: He's seen this before. Turn the clock back.
lines: Restores your HP and shield to what they were {8 s} ago
Resets the cooldowns of your other two abilities
Every goblin within {25 m} is flung back {10 yd} and stunned for {2 s}

weapon.name: Chain Lightning
weapon.desc: Arcs to 4 goblins, losing 20% damage per jump

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.text: Never stands still. Now he really can't.
lines: {+40%} move speed for {8 s}
Every jump and every landing releases a shock: {40} damage within {6 m}

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.text: Lightning finds the toughest goblins.
lines: {12} bolts strike the goblins with the most HP within {25 m}
{120} damage each, and they're stunned for {1.5 s}

abilities.name: Storm Lord
abilities.text: A thunderstorm follows you around.
lines: For {10 s}, a bolt strikes a goblin within {18 m} every {0.25 s}
Each bolt deals {90} damage and chains to {3} more goblins

weapon.name: Shadow Bolts
weapon.desc: Slow, piercing bolts; 20% chance to curse (+25% damage taken for 4 s)

abilities.name: Siphon
abilities.text: Drains the life out of everything nearby.
lines: Goblins within {12 m} lose {6%} of max HP per second for {4 s}
You heal {1} HP per goblin drained per second, up to {5%} of your max HP per second

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.text: The fallen get back up, on your side this time.
lines: The last {15} goblin corpses near you rise for {15 s} and fight the horde ({25} damage per hit)
When their time is up they explode for {60} damage within {3 m}

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.text: The sky goes black. They can't see you. You can see them.
lines: For {8 s}, goblins lose track of you and wander
You deal {+100%} damage
Every kill releases a shadow wisp that seeks a goblin for {60} damage

weapon.name: Tree Trunk
weapon.desc: Wide 120° cleave in front of you (3 m), heavy knockback

abilities.name: Bellow
abilities.text: GET OUT OF MY SWAMP.
lines: Goblins within {14 m} flee in terror for {4 s}
You gain {+30%} armor for {6 s}

abilities.name: Belly Flop
abilities.text: Leap and land on them. All of him.
lines: Leap up to {20 m} to where you aim
Landing deals {160} damage within {7 m} and stuns for {2 s}

abilities.name: Swamp Rage
abilities.text: Grows bigger and angrier.
lines: For {12 s}: {50%} bigger, {+60%} damage and immune to knockback
Your cleave hits all the way around you ({360°})
Each kill heals {2%} of your max HP

ghast.role: Untouchable spirit that terrifies the horde

weapon.name: Wail
weapon.desc: 8 m cone of sound in front of you that pierces everything and slows 25%

abilities.name: Phase
abilities.text: Drift through goblins, trees and walls.
lines: Intangible for {4 s}: no contact damage, and you pass through everything
Goblins you pass through take {30} damage and are slowed {50%} for {2 s}

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.text: Possess the biggest goblin around.
lines: Takes over the goblin with the most HP within {20 m} for {10 s} (epics first, not the boss)
It fights the horde with {3x} damage, then bursts for {50%} of its max HP within {4 m}

abilities.name: Banshee Scream
abilities.text: A scream nobody survives hearing twice.
lines: Goblins within {30 m} take {15%} of their max HP and flee for {6 s}
Goblins below {20%} HP die instantly (not the boss)

vampire_hunter.role: Precise ranged hunter, deadly to big targets

weapon.name: Silver Bolts
weapon.desc: Heavy crossbow bolts that pierce 3 goblins; double damage to epics

abilities.name: Holy Water
abilities.text: A flask of blessed water, thrown where you aim.
lines: Leaves a {8 m} pool for {6 s}
Goblins in it take {25} damage per second and are slowed {40%}

abilities.name: Stake Volley
abilities.text: Stakes fly out in every direction.
lines: Fires {16} stakes in a ring: {90} damage each
Goblins hit are pinned to the ground for {2 s}

abilities.name: Hunter's Night
abilities.text: The hunt is on.
lines: For {10 s}, goblins move at half speed
Your bolts lock on to the {3} goblins with the most HP and deal {3x} damage
Each kill heals {1%} of your max HP

vicki.role: Aerial lancer who dives on the horde

weapon.name: Valkyrie Spear
weapon.desc: Thrusts in a 6 m piercing line; every 4th throw is a javelin that flies 25 m

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.text: Brace behind your shield.
lines: Gain a shield worth {15%} of max HP for {6 s}
Goblins that hit you while it holds take {2x} their contact damage back

abilities.name: Wings of Valhalla
abilities.text: Take to the air, then come down spear-first.
lines: Leap high and glide for up to {4 s} (steer as you go)
Diving down deals {140} damage within {6 m}

abilities.name: Ride of the Valkyries
abilities.text: Her horse comes back. Just this once.
lines: A spectral winged horse charges through the horde {3} times in the direction you aim
{180} damage to every goblin on each pass
Kills during the ride heal you {1%} of max HP

rogue.role: Evasive striker with bleeds and bursts

weapon.name: Twin Daggers
weapon.desc: Fast, short-range throws in pairs; hits bleed for 3% of max HP per second for 3 s

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.text: Vanish in a puff of smoke.
lines: {8 m} smoke cloud; you're invisible for {4 s} and goblins lose track of you
Your first attack after the smoke deals {3x} damage

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.text: Dash through the crowd and help yourself.
lines: Dash {12 m} through up to {10} goblins: {70} damage each
Each goblin you pass drops an extra XP gem

abilities.name: Death by a Thousand Cuts
abilities.text: Blink from goblin to goblin faster than they can blink.
lines: Over {3 s}, strike the {20} nearest goblins: {120} damage each, plus a bleed
Invulnerable throughout; you return to where you started

weapon.name: Katana
weapon.desc: Fast 3-hit combo in a 3 m arc; the 3rd hit sends a wind slash 10 m

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.text: Appear behind your target. They won't hear you.
lines: Teleport behind the goblin with the most HP within {20 m} and strike for {250} damage
Invulnerable for {1.5 s} afterwards
Holds {2} charges

abilities.name: Shuriken Storm
abilities.text: Rings of shuriken spiral out from you.
lines: {3} rings of {12} shuriken over {2 s}
{50} damage each; they pierce

abilities.name: Reed Clones
abilities.text: Four of him. None of them make a sound.
lines: Summon {4} shadow clones for {12 s}
They copy your attacks at {60%} damage

dr_croc.role: Alchemist who melts goblins with acid

weapon.name: Volatile Flasks
weapon.desc: Lobbed flasks that burst for 30 damage in 3 m and leave acid (4% of max HP per second for 3 s)

abilities.name: Mutagen
abilities.text: Drinks his own experiment. Side effects include winning.
lines: {+50%} attack speed and {+30%} move speed for {8 s}
Side effect: you take {+10%} damage while it lasts

abilities.name: Death Roll
abilities.text: Spins forward, dragging goblins with him.
lines: Roll {15 m} where you aim, grabbing goblins in your path
{50} damage every {0.25 s} while held; they're flung away at the end

abilities.name: Toxic Spill
abilities.text: Knocks over the whole lab.
lines: A {20 m} flood of acid around you for {10 s}: {4%} of max HP per second
Goblins that die in it burst for {30%} of their max HP within {3 m}

weapon.name: Venom Spit
weapon.desc: Fast globs that poison for 3% of max HP per second for 4 s, stacking 3 times

abilities.name: Web Trap
abilities.text: Shoots a web where you aim.
lines: {10 m} web: goblins in it are stuck for {4 s}
Stuck goblins take {+30%} damage from poison

abilities.name: Brood
abilities.text: An egg sac hatches. Lunch is served.
lines: {12} spiderlings hatch and leap onto goblins for {15 s}
Each deals {20} damage per second and applies poison

abilities.name: Cocoon
abilities.text: Wraps everything nearby. Breakfast. And lunch.
lines: Every goblin within {25 m} is wrapped in silk for {5 s} (the boss is only slowed)
Cocooned goblins take {25%} of their max HP; you heal {1%} of max HP per cocoon

weapon.name: Acid Body
weapon.desc: Burns goblins touching you for 30 damage per second (2.5 m); grows with kills, up to +50% size

abilities.name: Engulf
abilities.text: Swallows the goblins closest to you.
lines: Absorbs up to {20} goblins within {6 m} (not the boss)
They're digested for {6 s}: {8%} of max HP per second, and you heal {1%} of max HP per goblin

abilities.name: Split
abilities.text: Two more of you. Equally hungry.
lines: {2} mini-blobs split off for {10 s} and chase goblins
Each has its own Acid Body at {60%} damage

abilities.name: The Great Puddle
abilities.text: Spreads out flat across the swamp.
lines: Become a {20 m} puddle for {6 s}: you can't move, but you're invulnerable
Goblins in it are slowed {90%} and take {6%} of max HP per second
When you pull back together, survivors are flung out {6 yd}

weapon.name: Scythe Sweep
weapon.desc: 360° spin every 1.5 s (4 m): 35 damage, instantly reaps goblins under 10% HP

abilities.name: Harvest
abilities.text: Collects what's owed.
lines: Reaps every goblin within {12 m} below {30%} HP (not the boss)
Each soul gives {+2%} damage for {20 s}, up to {+50%}

abilities.name: Mark of the Inevitable
abilities.text: Their time is up. In five seconds.
lines: Marks the {8} goblins with the most HP within {30 m}
After {5 s} each takes {400} damage

abilities.name: Overtime
abilities.text: He decided to stay a little longer.
lines: The run clock and goblin spawns stop for {10 s}
You deal {+100%} damage and kills drop {2x} XP

billy_bulldog.role: Scrappy melee dog with taunts and stuns

weapon.name: Bite
weapon.desc: Lunges at the nearest goblin (2 m) for 25 damage; every 5th bite shakes it for 3x

abilities.name: Fetch!
abilities.text: Throws his bone. The goblins want it more.
lines: Throw a bone up to {25 m}; goblins within {15 m} of it rush to it and squabble for {4 s}
Then the bone explodes for {100} damage within {5 m}

abilities.name: Zoomies
abilities.text: Sprints in circles for no reason.
lines: {+100%} move speed for {6 s}
Your dust trail deals {30} damage per second and knocks goblins back

abilities.name: Who's a Good Boy
abilities.text: Nobody can resist. Then he barks.
lines: Every goblin within {20 m} stops to pet you for {4 s}; you're invulnerable
Then a bark: {250} damage within {12 m} and big knockback

cowboy.role: Gunslinger with bursts of precise damage

weapon.name: Six-Shooter
weapon.desc: 6 rapid shots of 40 damage (pierce 1), then a 1.5 s reload

abilities.name: Lasso
abilities.text: Ropes the biggest goblin and uses it as a weapon.
lines: Lasso the goblin with the most HP within {20 m} and swing it around you for {3 s}
{60} damage to every goblin it hits, then you hurl it {15 m}

abilities.name: Dynamite
abilities.text: Three sticks, short fuses.
lines: Throws {3} sticks in a fan
Each explodes after {1.5 s} for {120} damage within {5 m}

abilities.name: High Noon
abilities.text: It's high noon somewhere.
lines: Time freezes for {2 s} while you mark up to {30} goblins in view
Then you fire: {300} damage to each

loco_robotico.role: Party robot that stuns crowds, then lasers them

weapon.name: Maraca Blasters
weapon.desc: Alternating sonic pulses in a 6 m cone: 20 damage each, faster while you keep moving

abilities.name: Party Mode
abilities.text: Drops a disco ball. Everyone dances.
lines: Goblins within {15 m} are forced to dance for {6 s} (they can't move or attack)
Dancing goblins take {5%} of max HP per second

abilities.name: Piñata Drop
abilities.text: Launches a piñata. It's full of explosives.
lines: A piñata lands where you aim; goblins swarm it, and it bursts after {3 s}
{20} candy bombs rain out: {60} damage each within {3 m}

abilities.name: DESTROY Mode
abilities.text: Switches from DANCE to DESTROY.
lines: For {12 s}, twin lasers sweep around you to {20 m}
{8%} of max HP per second to goblins in the beams; {+50%} armor

singe.role: Fast fire imp who sets the ground ablaze

weapon.name: Cinder Toss
weapon.desc: Lobbed hot coals that leave small fires (10 damage per second for 2 s)

abilities.name: Hotfoot
abilities.text: Runs around leaving scorch marks on everything.
lines: {+40%} move speed for {6 s}, leaving burning footprints that last {4 s}
Goblins that touch them burn for {4%} of max HP per second for {3 s}

abilities.name: Flashover
abilities.text: Every fire he's lit goes off at once.
lines: Every fire on the ground erupts: {100} damage within {3 m} of each
Each eruption leaves a fresh fire behind

abilities.name: Supernova
abilities.text: Gets very, very hot.
lines: Glow white-hot for {3 s} (you take no damage), then explode: {300} damage within {25 m}, plus a {3 s} burn
Afterwards you're a tiny cinder with {+50%} move speed for {5 s}

argyle_sock.role: Odd little whirlwind with static shocks

weapon.name: Static Cling
weapon.desc: Zaps the 3 nearest goblins for 18 damage; builds up to 2x damage while you keep moving

abilities.name: Spin Cycle
abilities.text: Spins like it's back in the machine.
lines: Become a whirlwind for {5 s}, pulling goblins within {6 m} in
{40} damage every {0.5 s} to goblins inside

abilities.name: Lost Pair
abilities.text: Finds its missing partner. Briefly.
lines: Your partner sock fights beside you for {15 s}
It copies your attacks, and when both of you zap the same goblin it takes {2x} damage

abilities.name: Laundry Day
abilities.text: A washing machine falls from the sky.
lines: Lands where you aim, sucks in every goblin within {10 m} and washes them for {4 s}: {10%} of max HP per second
Survivors come out shrunk: half damage and {double} damage taken for {20 s}

platypus.role: Poison-kicking scholar with sleep and eggs

weapon.name: Venom Spur
weapon.desc: Melee kick that poisons for 2% of max HP per second; each stack slows 10% (max 5)

abilities.name: Electro-Bill
abilities.text: Senses every goblin nearby. Then shocks them.
lines: Electric pulse to {15 m}: {60} damage
Goblins hit are stunned for {1.5 s}

abilities.name: Egg Clutch
abilities.text: Lays eggs. Monotremes do that.
lines: Lays {4} eggs around you that hatch after {2 s}
Each puggle explodes for {80} damage within {4 m} and poisons

abilities.name: The Lecture
abilities.text: Reads aloud from his treatise on monotremes.
lines: Every goblin within {25 m} falls asleep for {6 s} (the boss is only slowed)
Sleeping goblins take {double} poison damage; the first hit wakes them for {3x} damage

bog_witch.role: Hexer who curses and drowns the horde

weapon.name: Ladle of Bile
weapon.desc: Lobs bile that splashes for 25 damage in 3 m and slows 20%

abilities.name: Bubbling Cauldron
abilities.text: Sets down her cauldron. It spits.
lines: A cauldron stands for {15 s}, spitting a glob at a goblin within {15 m} every second: {50} damage
You heal {2%} of max HP per second while standing next to it

abilities.name: Hex of Silence
abilities.text: Three hundred years, and now THIS noise.
lines: Goblins within {20 m} are hexed for {8 s} and take {+40%} damage
A hexed goblin that dies passes the hex on to {2} neighbours

abilities.name: Swamp's Fury
abilities.text: The bog rises up and grabs them.
lines: The ground within {30 m} turns to bog for {12 s}: goblins are slowed {70%}
Every second, hands drag the {3} nearest goblins under (elites and the boss take {25%} of max HP instead)

toadstool_knight.role: Brave little defender with spores and summons

weapon.name: Spore Blade
weapon.desc: Sword slash in a 3 m arc: 30 damage, leaves a spore cloud (2% of max HP per second)

abilities.name: Fungal Shield
abilities.text: Raises a shield cap.
lines: Gain a shield worth {20%} of max HP for {8 s}
When it breaks or runs out, it bursts into spores: {60} damage within {8 m}, plus poison

abilities.name: Fairy Ring
abilities.text: A ring of mushrooms springs up around you.
lines: A {10 m} ring lasts {10 s}
Goblins that cross it take {50} damage and wander confused for {3 s}

abilities.name: The Fungus Court
abilities.text: His liege lords arrive.
lines: {6} giant toadstool guardians rise in a {12 m} ring around you for {15 s}
Each draws goblins to it and slams every {1.5 s}: {80} damage within {4 m}

kong.role: Brawler who throws the swamp at goblins

weapon.name: Shackle Swing
weapon.desc: Swings his chains around him (4 m): 30 damage and knockback

abilities.name: Chest Pound
abilities.text: Three pounds. Three shockwaves.
lines: {3} shockwaves to {10 m}: {50} damage each
The last one stuns for {2 s}

abilities.name: Log Toss
abilities.text: Rips up a log and bowls it at them.
lines: Hurls a log that rolls {30 m} where you aim
{120} damage to every goblin it flattens

abilities.name: Rampage
abilities.text: Snaps his shackles. Uses the pieces.
lines: For {12 s}: {+80%} damage and {+50%} move speed
Every {3rd} step quakes for {60} damage within {6 m}
The broken chains fly out to {25 m}, lashing goblins

thog.role: Slow, heavy smasher who controls space

weapon.name: Big Club
weapon.desc: Overhead smash in a 4 m cone: 50 damage, slow but with heavy knockback

abilities.name: Toll Booth
abilities.text: None shall pass. Without paying.
lines: For {8 s}, every goblin that comes within {6 m} pays the toll: {80} damage
Each one that pays drops an XP gem

abilities.name: Goat Charge
abilities.text: He learned this one from the goat.
lines: Charge {20 m} headfirst where you aim
Goblins hit take {120} damage and are thrown {8 yd}

abilities.name: Bridge Collapse
abilities.text: Brings his old bridge down on them.
lines: A stone bridge crashes down on a {25 m} line where you aim: {350} damage
The rubble stays for {10 s} as a wall goblins can't cross
